Object detetion
- One stage Object detection
    - YOLO, SSD, Retina-Net, Single shot multi-box
- Two steps Object detection
    - RCNN, Fast RCNN, Faster RCNN, Pyramid Networks
Steps
1) Bouding boxes around objects
2) Classes or names of objects

Challenges
1) Intra Class variance: 
    Objects of the same class can look very different.
2) Pose variation
    - Rigit transformation
        Ex: Car where the structure does not change
    - Non-Rigid transformation
        Ex: Human: Body, Hands and legs can move changing the structure
3) Occlusion
    - Object of interest can be partially occluded by other objects in the scene
4) Large search space over multiple
    - Locations
    - Scale
    - Aspect ratio
5) Crowded Scene
    - Too many objects in the scene

6) Datasets
    1) PASCAL VOC
        - 20 object categories
        - 11K objects
    2) MS COCO
        - 91 common ojbect categories
        - 2.5 M labeled instances
        - 328K images
    3) IMAGENET(2014)
        - 200 Object categories
        - 500k images
        - 20K - Validation images
        - 40K - Test images
        - ~ 575 object instances

7) Object Detection Evaluation Metrices
    - Intersection and Union
        - IOU = area of overlap / area of union
        - To evaluate detection, we need to set threshold
            if IoU > Threshold = Prediction intersects well with the ground
            Ground Truth BBox, Prediction BBox
        - IoU threadhold determins how well localization works
    - Confidence Score
        - Confidence score is the probability that the bounding box contains object
        - Usually predicted by the classifier
        - We need to set Confidence threshold which is different from IoU threshold
        - Confidence Threshold refers to the probabiity of finding an object inside the bounding box.
8) How to evaluate detection?
    - It is considered True Positive (TP) only if
        - Confidence Score > Confidence Threshold
        - IoU > IoU threshold
    - False Positive
        - Confidence Score > Confidence Threshold
        - No ground truth bounding box(IoU = 0)
            - IoU < IoU threshold
    - False Negative
        - Confidence Score < Confidence Threshold
        - No bounding boxes detected near ground truth bounding box
            - IoU < IoU threshold
    - Recall: It is the ability of a model to find all rlevant objects
        Recall = TP / (TP + FN) = TP / (all ground truth)
    - Precision: It is the ability to identify only the relevant objects
        Precision = TP / (TP + FP) = TP / (all detections)
    - Recall - Precision curve
    - When Confidene threshold decreases, Recall increases, Precision may increase or decrease
    - Mean Average Precision(mAP)
    - Average Precision metric is the area under Recall-Precision curve. Higher its better.
    AP11-points = 1/11 sigmar E{0, 0.0, ...,1}pinterp(r)
    mAP = (1 / N) E N to class=0 APclass 

Pipeline for Object Detection
------------------------------
1) Input Image: 
2) Generate Proposals : Guesses for bounding boxes that may contain objects. Generate bounding boxes which may contain objects
    - Background subraction
    - Sliding Window
    - Image pyramid
    - Selective Search
3) Classify Regions: Image Classification in the Bounding box
4) Non-Maximum Suppression
